title: The Traditional House
preview: The traditional house shows the intelligence of a small island home. In less than 20 square meters, family life, cooking, storage, sleep and craft all had their place.
details: This house is more than 130 years old. Families of many generations could share one compact room, arranging each object with care because space was precious.
The fireplace was the heart of the home, used for cooking, warmth and gathering. Nearby objects such as the hand mill, plates and kitchenware show the daily rhythm of preparing food.

items.label: Rest and storage
items.text: Beds, storage spaces, a cradle and a hanging bread keeper solved practical needs in a crowded household.

items.label: Food keeping
items.text: Before electric refrigeration, ice and clever airflow helped keep food cool and water fresh.

items.label: Work and identity
items.text: The loom, chest, uniforms, photographs and religious images speak about work, ceremony, memory and belonging.

items.label: Careful design
items.text: Nothing was accidental; each object had a place and a purpose.

details: Continue to the bakery, where the village story moves from the family hearth to the communal stone oven.
